summary: This dispatch built the three F02 documents for visual review with make doc (provider claude), confirmed clean logs, embedded subset Type 1 fonts, clean extraction and the page requirements, recorded the snapshot, generated the rasters, and appended the build-artifacts audit to research/production-review.md, with no source or layout edits. Expansive study 31 pages (sha256 215c58fa6f029ed11b31c130a6c59cb0686bf82c1691ed8ea811bca1a61dbd4a); concise study 11 pages (99dfb13bfbf465534362eaaf8a3e543566091444d99749409211bf77e49a0bb5), with inventory, overview and all four sense markers on physical page 1, chronology on 2, themes on 3-4 and commentary starting on 5 per the settled aux; homily 4 pages (9114d448930550081e6db81281e5d1efa60257dfadfc6a6a608c84d5e789e79b, byte-identical to the derive-homily iteration 1 proof). None of the logs or the full build output shows an error, overfull/underfull box, undefined or multiply defined reference, rerun request or font warning. All three PDFs parse in Ghostscript and pdfinfo. tools/check-proper-components --phase artifacts passes for all three editions. Snapshot written to research/artifacts.json (sha256 d4089a2fd954076a60547c866a22c93931ddc73f08f3cc570bf6e979152344d4). Rasters and contact sheets are in build/tpt-runs/450355254538c1ba/artifacts/build-artifacts-0/rasters, and logs, aux, toc and extracted text are kept in the sibling evidence/ directory. Limitations: this stage viewed pages only on contact sheets, so the full-page visual inspection and the page-2 lookup belong to the visual reviewer; the PDFs are untagged; qpdf is not installed, so structure was checked by parse only. No new defects for other owners.
